// Statechart definition (simplified representation for illustrative purposes)

States:
- Idle
- CheckingInput
- AlarmTriggered
- Responding
- Unresponsive

Transitions:
  - Idle -> CheckingInput on "start alarm check"
  - CheckingInput (input air line blocked) -> AlarmTriggered on "low pressure detected"
  - CheckingInput (input O2 line blocked) -> AlarmTriggered on "low pressure detected"
  - CheckingInput (input O2 line pressure too high) -> AlarmTriggered on "high pressure detected"
  - AlarmTriggered -> Responding
  - Responding -> Unresponsive on "alarm unresponsive for 0.5 apnea time"
  - Responding -> Idle on "alarm responsive"
  - Unresponsive (controller) -> Idle on "controller responsive for 0.5 apnea time"
  - Unresponsive (controller) -> Idle on "controller unresponsive for 0.5 apnea time"
  - Idle -> AlarmTriggered on "start alarm check"
  - AlarmTriggered (low pressure) -> Responding
  - AlarmTriggered (high pressure) -> Responding
  - Responding (pressure below -4cm H2O) -> Unresponsive
  - Responding (pressure above 60 cmH2O) -> Responding

// Note: The above transitions are a high-level representation and would need to be fleshed out with proper states and guards in a real Statechart implementation.
